page_update_policy: Region pages consume this contract; do not copy an old region HTML file as a visual baseline.

renderer.input: Top-level general array is required, bohe array is optional, and config plus modeConfig provide every regional display value.
renderer.template_rule: The canonical template contains no region, radius, category, venue-name, or mode-specific quick-pick logic.
renderer.food_filters: Generate FOOD filter buttons from the active mode's venue categories.

tabs.zeroBoheCandidates: Hide the entire tab control with display:none and render only 일반 추천.
tabs.positiveBoheCandidates: Render switchable in-place 일반 추천 and 보헤 추천 tabs; the selected tab alone supplies metrics, marker rail, quick picks, and cards.

actions.distinctDestinationRule: Render no duplicate identical action URL; an optional curation action must be a distinct URL.
actions.savedSourceRule: For a Bohe venue, show exactly one representative curation source URL even if the private DB has multiple Instagram or blog URLs.

boheCards.provenancePlacement: Use the fit sentence, e.g. 보헤가 저장한 성수권 핫치킨 버거 후보.
boheCards.naverSignalRule: NAVER SIGNAL contains only Naver visitor and blog metrics; never place 보헤 DB or source provenance there.

addressDisplay.layoutRule: Use a factually shortened address that fits on one line; never wrap, ellipsize, or invent an address.
